title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.106
exact_target: Do finitely many values of any one-variable first-order formula always generate a finite subgroup inside a residually finite group?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2615 (KOU-21.106). CC BY 4.0.

M. Petschick, Problem 21.106, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). This version records a negative answer; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
